 "cells": [

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "54c6383a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Events\n",
    "\n",
    "Events are time points marked during a recording, usually triggers that\n",
    "the experiment software sends to the eye tracker (e.g., \"stimulus on\",\n",
    "\"response\"). Each event has an onset time and a label. This tutorial\n",
    "shows how to look at events, select the ones you need and change them,\n",
    "using the `Events` class."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "7e7b5f9a",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T13:34:20.829527Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T13:34:20.829154Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.266361Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.264939Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import pypillometry as pp\n",
    "from pypillometry import u\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "pp.logging_set_level(\"WARNING\")\n",
    "\n",
    "d = pp.get_example_data(\"rlmw_002_short\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fc338c3a",
   "metadata": {},

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b3cf92c4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**A function** is called with each label and selects the events for which\n",
    "it returns `True`. In this dataset, the labels of the `R` events end with\n",
    "a number; here we select those where it is larger than 18:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "a8d6a63b",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.339491Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.339197Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.347037Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.345896Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [
       "<table border=\"1\" class=\"dataframe\">\n",
       "  <thead>\n",
       "    <tr style=\"text-align: right;\">\n",
       "      <th></th>\n",
       "      <th>Onset (ms)</th>\n",
       "      <th>Label</th>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "  </thead>\n",
       "  <tbody>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>0</th>\n",
       "      <td>10808.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>R_2_20</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>1</th>\n",
       "      <td>25153.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>R_6_20</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>2</th>\n",
       "      <td>35932.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>R_9_19</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "  </tbody>\n",
       "</table><p style=\"font-size: 0.9em; color: #666; margin-top: 8px;\">Total: 3 events</p>"
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "Events: 3 events | units=ms"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 8,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "def high_number(label):\n",
    "    parts = label.split(\"_\")\n",
    "    return parts[0] == \"R\" and int(parts[-1]) > 18\n",
    "\n",
    "events.filter(high_number)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "bf3fffeb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**A tuple** `(start, end)` selects events by their onset, in the units of\n",
    "the `Events` object (here, ms):"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "60f62d72",

  {

   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "`test_selector()` shows which events of a dataset a selector picks out, which\n",
    "is useful while writing a selection function:"
   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "70985d8d",
   "metadata": {

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "979e05f8",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plotting events\n",
    "\n",
    "`plot()` shows when the events happened. Each event is a point; the\n",
    "labels of some of them are shown (use `show_labels=\"all\"` for all):"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "c0d01fb8",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.381917Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.381421Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.793574Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.792260Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1200x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 4))\n",
    "events.filter(\"S_\").plot(units=\"sec\", show_labels=\"all\");"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ce1585a1",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Events are also shown in most plots of the data, e.g., in\n",
    "`d.plot.plot_pupil()`.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Using events for intervals\n",
    "\n",
    "Analyses usually look at the data around events. `get_epochs()` takes\n",
    "the same kinds of selectors as `filter()` (string or function), and also\n",
    "an `Events` object. This makes it easy to use any selection of events,\n",
    "e.g., only the first five stimuli:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "4362fa78",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.797084Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.796685Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.804188Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.802266Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Epochs 'events_5' | 5 epochs, window (-200, 800) ms"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 13,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "first_stimuli = events.filter(\"S_\")[:5]\n",
    "d.get_epochs(first_stimuli, (-200, 800) * u.ms)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7f315f5c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "See the [Intervals tutorial](intervals.ipynb) for more on intervals.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Creating and changing events\n",
    "\n",
    "`Events` objects can also be created directly. Onsets with units are\n",
    "converted, and the object keeps the units:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "1ae58073",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.808976Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.808529Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.817764Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.816564Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [
       "<table border=\"1\" class=\"dataframe\">\n",
       "  <thead>\n",
       "    <tr style=\"text-align: right;\">\n",
       "      <th></th>\n",
       "      <th>Onset (sec)</th>\n",
       "      <th>Label</th>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "  </thead>\n",
       "  <tbody>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>0</th>\n",
       "      <td>1.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>start</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>1</th>\n",
       "      <td>2.5</td>\n",
       "      <td>probe</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>2</th>\n",
       "      <td>4.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>end</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "  </tbody>\n",
       "</table><p style=\"font-size: 0.9em; color: #666; margin-top: 8px;\">Total: 3 events</p>"
      ],

      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 14,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "my_events = pp.Events([1, 2.5, 4] * u.sec, [\"start\", \"probe\", \"end\"])\n",
    "my_events"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b9608dbb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "`Events` cannot be changed in place; `set_events()` replaces the events of\n",
    "a dataset with new ones. For example, we can\n",
    "shorten the labels to just the event type (the first letter). The onsets\n",
    "stay the same:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "id": "12164cd4",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.821032Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.820591Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.830141Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.828808Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [

       "      <th>Label</th>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",

       "      <th>0</th>\n",
       "      <td>5177.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>F</td>\n",

       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>4</th>\n",
       "      <td>8776.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>F</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",

     "execution_count": 15,

   ],
   "source": [
    "short_labels = [label.split(\"_\")[0] for label in events.labels]\n",
    "d.set_events(pp.Events(events.onsets, short_labels))\n",
    "d.events[:6]"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f0ed0a02",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Like the other `set_*` methods, `set_events()` always changes the object\n",
    "in place; use `d.copy().set_events(...)` to keep the original.\n",
    "\n",
    "As another example, we add the onset of each blink as an event. Blinks\n",
    "are stored as `Intervals` (see the [blinks tutorial](blinks.ipynb)); we\n",
    "take their start times in ms, combine them with the existing events and\n",
    "sort everything by time:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "id": "e050b227",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T13:34:22.833551Z",

    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {

       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>4</th>\n",
       "      <td>7010.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>R</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>5</th>\n",

       "      <td>blink</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>6</th>\n",

       "    </tr>\n",

       "      <td>blink</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>8</th>\n",
       "      <td>8776.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>F</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>9</th>\n",
       "      <td>9575.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>S</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>10</th>\n",
       "      <td>10484.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>blink</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>11</th>\n",
       "      <td>10581.0</td>\n",
       "      <td>C</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",

       "</table><p style=\"font-size: 0.9em; color: #666; margin-top: 8px;\">Total: 12 events</p>"
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "Events: 12 events | units=ms"

     },
     "execution_count": 16,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "d.pupil.blinks_detect()\n",
    "blinks = d.get_blinks(\"left\", \"pupil\", units=\"ms\")[\"left_pupil\"]\n",
    "blink_onsets = [start for start, end in blinks]\n",
    "\n",
    "events = d.events\n",
    "onsets = np.concatenate([events.onsets, blink_onsets])\n",
    "labels = np.concatenate([events.labels, [\"blink\"] * len(blink_onsets)])\n",
    "order = np.argsort(onsets)\n",
    "d.set_events(pp.Events(onsets[order], labels[order]))\n",
    "\n",
    "d.events[:12]"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1ab62019",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The blink onsets can now be used like any other event, e.g., to look at\n",
    "the pupil around blinks with `d.get_epochs(\"blink\", ...)`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "meta-pointer",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "Events can also carry more information, such as the trial, the condition or the reaction time, decomposed from the labels or taken from a behaviour log. Events can then be selected by it, e.g., `events.filter(\"S_\", cond=\"easy\")`. See the [event metadata tutorial](event_metadata.ipynb)."
   ]
  }
